title: A Fraction class with <=>
hints: Normalise in the constructor: divide by `std::gcd` (`<numeric>`) and keep the denominator positive.
Compare `a/b` and `c/d` by comparing `a*d` and `c*b` (denominators are positive), returning `std::strong_ordering`.
`operator<<` is a free function: `os << num << '/' << den`, and just `num` when `den == 1`.
